whenToExpectSeniorFreeze.title: When can I expect to receive a Senior Freeze payment?

julToSep.text: If you applied before May 1, you can expect to receive your payment between July 15 and September 15.

sepToOct.text: If you applied between May 1 and June 1, you can expect to receive your payment between September 1 and October 1.

nov.text: If you applied between June 2 and September 1, you can expect to receive your payment between November 2 and January 2, 2027.

dec.text: If you applied between September 2 and October 31, you can expect to receive your payment between December 2, 2026 and February 2, 2027.

whenToExpectAnchor.title: When can I expect to receive an ANCHOR payment?

oct.text: Payments start going out October 1, 2026. In some cases, payments will be made after 2026.

whenToExpectStay.title: When can I expect to receive a Stay NJ payment?

content.quarterly: Stay NJ payments are paid out quarterly

feb.text: Payments start going out next year in February of next year.

may.text: The second payment starts going out in May of next year.

aug.text: The third payment starts going out in August of next year.

nov.text: The fourth payment starts going out in November of next year.
